subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should this iOS preview-tour onboarding mode be adopted on top of the current-main onboarding refresh, narrowed to a smaller follow-up, or paused in favor of the newer baseline?
rationale: The branch adds a new preview/sample first-run mode while current main has since landed overlapping onboarding setup, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions, so the remaining choice is product direction plus conflict resolution rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh first-run/preview/configured-user proof.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection-path and setup-baseline behavior to the already merged onboarding work.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh and focused onboarding PRs as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh first-run/preview/configured-user proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main routing fixes touch the same startup/Gateway-entry decision surface and are the clearest owner signal for the compatibility side of the product choice.
